Pre-Rolls in NYC

Pre-rolls are the single largest category on New York menus, with about 9,990 listings across the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, from 456 brands. The format ranges from 0.5-gram singles and mini multi-packs to infused joints and blunts, and it is the easiest way to buy flower without a grinder or papers. Ruby Farms leads with 752 listings, far ahead of Dank By Definition at 304, Florist Farms at 280, Jeeter at 277, Anthem at 248, Dogwalkers at 227, Claybourne Co. at 211 and STIIIZY at 200.

Prices start at $5.31, with uninfused singles typically $9 to $15 before tax, infused singles $16 to $25, and multi-packs like Ruby Farms' seven-pack Doobies around $38. Midtown has the deepest selection at about 1,216 listings, led by Qube's 650, then Chelsea and Flatiron at 853, the Villages at 754, Sheepshead Bay at 654, the Upper West Side at 555 and Williamsburg at 504. In Queens, ENFLOR in Jackson Heights and Terp Bros in Astoria carry the largest pre-roll menus; in Brooklyn, Happy Buds in Bed-Stuy is the most pre-roll-focused shop with 153 of its 371 listings.

Pre-Rolls FAQ
What is an infused pre-roll?

A joint with concentrate added, usually live resin, kief or diamonds, which raises potency well above plain flower. Florist Farms, Jeeter and Alibi are common infused brands in New York, with singles around $16 to $25 before tax.

What are the cheapest pre-rolls in New York?

In our data the floor is $5.31, and uninfused singles from 5 Boro, Juan Roll and Nanticoke run $9 to $10 at many shops. Dank By Definition lists singles from $7.50 at Cannavita in Astoria.

Which dispensary has the most pre-rolls?

Qube in Midtown, with about 650 listings. Twenty8gramz in Sheepshead Bay, Stash Master in Bushwick and The Flowery Upper West Side are the deepest outside Midtown.
